compile_note: Inductor needs Triton, which has no Windows build.

evaluation.interval_note: A crash costs everything since the last evaluation, and the trainer reads its config out of the checkpoint on resume, so this cannot be changed once the run has started.

stage_note: One stage. Started with --init-from on the pretrained weights, so the optimizer and schedule are fresh. The peak LR is 3e-5, a sixteenth of pretraining's 6e-4: SFT teaches the model to take the request in words, and a rate high enough to move the prose is high enough to wreck it. 66M tokens of instruction/response pairs at 131,072 tokens per update is about 500 updates an epoch; 1000 is two epochs, which is where instruction tuning usually stops earning.
